meta.title: AFM Orbital Field Journal icon exploration
meta.anchor: Personal portfolio for Al-Faris Mujahid AlZakwani, an Omani physics student, front-end engineer, AI-agent builder, and aspiring astronaut
meta.summary: Explore favicon-first identity marks that feel native to the portfolio's dark orbital-console interface.

preserve: space, physics, trajectory, and systems-thinking context
site palette: ink #060b18, cyan #86e5e0, amber #f4b860, blue #7999ff, paper #eef4f1
sparse telemetry geometry and technical precision
strong silhouette at 16 px, 32 px, and 64 px
avoid: tiny lettering, taglines, mockups, watermarks, or decorative background scenes

routes.label: Orbital Monogram
routes.prompt: Create one original favicon-first logo icon for AFM / Field Notes, the personal portfolio of an aspiring astronaut, physics student, front-end engineer, and AI-agent builder. Direction: a highly simplified AFM monogram built from one continuous orbital line, with the crossbar or terminal becoming a small amber trajectory node. Geometric, precise, sparse, technical, and unmistakable at 16 px. Use a square dark ink #060b18 canvas, primary cyan #86e5e0 strokes, one small amber #f4b860 accent, optional off-white #eef4f1. Flat vector-like graphic, centered, generous negative space, no wordmark, no tiny text, no gradients, no mockup, no border label, no NASA styling, no detailed rocket.
routes.rationale: Connects the owner's initials directly to the orbital visual language already used throughout the interface.
routes.best_for: A distinctive personal identity that can live in the browser tab and header.
routes.decision_advice: Choose this if recognizability of AFM matters more than an explicit rocket symbol.
routes.watch_out: The letter construction must remain readable without becoming busy.
routes.next_step: Redraw the selected monogram on a strict grid and test at 16 px.

routes.label: Launch Vector A
routes.prompt: Create one original favicon-first logo icon for AFM / Field Notes. Direction: a minimal capital A suggested by two launch-vector lines and a small ascending capsule or arrow cut from negative space; include a single orbit arc crossing the lower third and one amber telemetry node. It should feel like a mission-navigation instrument, not a generic tech logo. Square dark ink #060b18 canvas, cyan #86e5e0 structure, amber #f4b860 accent, optional blue #7999ff secondary detail. Flat vector-like geometry, bold simple silhouette, centered, no letters besides the implied A, no words, no gradients, no mockup, no NASA styling, no detailed rocket.
routes.rationale: Turns the first initial into a launch trajectory without relying on literal illustration.
routes.best_for: A dynamic, memorable icon with a clear upward-motion cue.
routes.decision_advice: Choose this if the astronaut path should be immediately felt while keeping the mark abstract.
routes.watch_out: Avoid looking like a generic navigation or crypto logo.
routes.next_step: Simplify to two stroke weights and verify the negative-space A at favicon size.

routes.label: Trajectory Core
routes.prompt: Create one original favicon-first logo icon for AFM / Field Notes. Direction: a compact central mission core with three asymmetrical orbital arcs and one outward launch vector, echoing a trajectory console. The core may subtly suggest the initials AFM through three radial segments but must work as a pure symbol. Square dark ink #060b18 canvas, cyan #86e5e0 arcs, amber #f4b860 launch node, restrained blue #7999ff secondary vector, off-white #eef4f1 core. Flat vector-like graphic, technical and sparse, strong at 16 px, centered, no text, no gradients, no mockup, no NASA imitation, no detailed spacecraft.
routes.rationale: Directly translates the site's interactive trajectory-console language into a compact brand symbol.
routes.best_for: The closest visual match to the current interface system.
routes.decision_advice: Choose this if system coherence matters more than literal initials.
routes.watch_out: Too many orbital arcs can collapse into visual noise at small sizes.
routes.next_step: Reduce the selected construction to a maximum of four primary shapes.

routes.label: Mission Patch
routes.prompt: Create one original mission-patch-inspired icon for AFM / Field Notes, optimized first for favicon use. Direction: a restrained circular badge with a simplified AFM monogram at the center, one diagonal orbital path, and one amber star-like telemetry point. Contemporary scientific field-journal character, not military and not an agency seal. Square dark ink #060b18 canvas; off-white #eef4f1 and cyan #86e5e0 linework; one amber #f4b860 accent. Flat vector-like graphic, thick enough for 16 px, minimal internal detail, no surrounding words, no dates, no flags, no official seal language, no gradients, no mockup, no NASA imitation.
routes.rationale: Adds the emotional usefulness of a mission patch while staying within the site's quiet technical style.
routes.best_for: A versatile identity that can extend beyond the website into presentations and physical items.
routes.decision_advice: Choose this if the portfolio should feel like an evolving personal mission archive.
routes.watch_out: Circular badges can feel institutional or generic if the center is not distinctive.
routes.next_step: Develop a core badge and a simplified favicon submark from the same geometry.

routes.label: Signal Beacon
routes.prompt: Create one original favicon-first logo icon for AFM / Field Notes. Direction: a minimal telemetry beacon made from a bright central dot, two incomplete orbital rings, and a single diagonal signal line that subtly forms an F. The mark should feel like a live spacecraft signal received by a calm scientific interface. Square dark ink #060b18 canvas, cyan #86e5e0 rings, amber #f4b860 core or node, optional off-white #eef4f1 line. Flat vector-like graphic, restrained glow only if it survives small sizes, centered, bold negative space, no text, no gradients, no mockup, no radio-tower cliché, no NASA styling.
routes.rationale: Builds from the site's signal ribbon, status dots, and 'channel open' language.
routes.best_for: An icon that can animate elegantly in the interface while remaining static-friendly.
routes.decision_advice: Choose this if the digital systems and AI side should balance the space theme.
routes.watch_out: It must avoid reading as Wi-Fi or podcast branding.
routes.next_step: Prototype a subtle two-state pulse animation after the static mark is finalized.

routes.label: Ascent Window
routes.prompt: Create one original favicon-first logo icon for AFM / Field Notes. Direction: an extremely restrained abstract ascent window: a rounded-square or open-frame aperture cut by one elegant upward orbital curve, with a tiny amber destination node. The negative space may subtly suggest a P for portfolio or an A for Al-Faris without forcing legibility. Quiet, editorial, scientific, premium, and compatible with Space Grotesk and IBM Plex Mono. Square dark ink #060b18 canvas, mostly off-white #eef4f1 and cyan #86e5e0 with one amber #f4b860 accent. Flat vector-like graphic, minimal shapes, strong silhouette, no text, no gradients, no mockup, no space-agency styling, no literal rocket.
routes.rationale: Tests the most refined and least literal expression of the portfolio's trajectory theme.
routes.best_for: A mature long-term personal brand that will not age with a single career label.
routes.decision_advice: Choose this if timelessness and visual restraint are more important than explicit space symbolism.
routes.watch_out: The abstraction needs one ownable geometric gesture to avoid blandness.
routes.next_step: Tune the aperture proportions and create light/dark one-color variants.
